name: lavision-school
description: lavision — gestion scolaire de l'inscription à la proclamation

scripts.dev:api: npm run build:packages && npm run prisma:generate && npm run dev --workspace @lavision/api
scripts.dev:api:local: npm run setup:local && npm run dev:api
scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:worker && npm run build:web
scripts.build:api: npm run build:packages && npm run prisma:generate && npm run build --workspace @lavision/api
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @lavision/contracts && npm run build --workspace @lavision/testing
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run prisma:generate && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:packages && npm run prisma:generate && npm run test:integration --workspace @lavision/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run prisma:generate && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.openapi: npm run build:packages && npm run openapi --workspace @lavision/api
scripts.openapi:check: npm run build:packages && npm run openapi:check --workspace @lavision/api
